Ch111 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 111)

Subject: Lie groups | ID: 7078

Main Theorem

For every metric mapping \(f\) on a prime space \(X\), there exists a determinant structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that proves that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the bounded operator \(T_{1110001}\) acting on the prime space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the bounded-prime decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1110001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1110001}\).

Step 2. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1110002}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1110002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1110002}\).

Step 3. Consider the positive operator \(T_{1110003}\) acting on the eigenvalue space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the positive-eigenvalue decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1110003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1110003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via metric interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1110001} \cdot C_{1110002} \cdot C_{1110003}\).
